# hyperfluid_agent_slack_channel (Resource)

The Slack channel of an agent: a Slack app in Socket Mode, so no public endpoint is needed. Creating it sets the channel and lists `slack` in the agent's interfaces; destroying it removes both, and the agent stays. Create the Slack app from the `hyperfluid_agent_slack_manifest` data source, and store its two tokens as plaintext secrets. Every change sends the whole channel configuration again: an argument removed from the configuration returns to the platform's default. A channel removed outside Terraform leaves the state, and the next apply sets it again. The status attributes (`phase`, `identity`, `message`, `last_event_at`) are the gateway's and are refreshed on read without planning changes. The platform refuses a channel on a capability, and on an agent whose tools include general `hfctl` unless the agent sets `allow_platform_tools`. Imported by agent id. Needs the organization's `sapience_agent_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_secret" "slack_bot_token" {
  name = "slack-bot-token"
}

data "hyperfluid_secret" "slack_app_token" {
  name = "slack-app-token"
}

resource "hyperfluid_agent_slack_channel" "this" {
  agent_id            = hyperfluid_agent.support.id
  bot_token_secret_id = data.hyperfluid_secret.slack_bot_token.id
  app_token_secret_id = data.hyperfluid_secret.slack_app_token.id
  team_id             = "T0123456789"
  allowed_channels    = ["C0123456789"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_agent`. Changing this forces a new Slack channel.
- `app_token_secret_id` (String) The Slack app's app-level token (`xapp-…`, scope `connections:write`), for Socket Mode. The id of a plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` of the organization: the value is never sent or stored by Terraform.
- `bot_token_secret_id` (String) The Slack app's bot token (`xoxb-…`). The id of a plaintext `hyperfluid_secret` of the organization: the value is never sent or stored by Terraform.
- `team_id` (String) The Slack workspace id (`T…`). Events from any other workspace, Slack Connect included, are dropped.

### Optional

- `allowed_channels` (Set of String) Channel ids the bot answers in. Left out, every channel it is invited to.
- `allowed_users` (Set of String) User ids the bot answers. Left out, everyone in the workspace.
- `direct_messages` (Boolean) Whether the bot answers direct messages. Left out, the platform's default (off).

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the channel is active: its configuration is present and its interface listed on the agent.
- `id` (String) The agent id.
- `identity` (String) Who the bot is on the network, as the gateway reports it.
- `last_event_at` (String) When the gateway last saw an event, RFC 3339.
- `message` (String) The gateway's detail on the current phase.
- `phase` (String) The gateway's phase for this channel: `Connecting`, `Connected`, `NeedsLogin`, `Degraded` or `Disabled`. Empty until the operator has reported it. Refreshed on read, it never plans a change on its own.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the agent id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_agent_slack_channel.this 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
